basis: All nine generated diagnostic pages inspected. Three or fewer selected station windows per candidate; qualitative agent review, not expert-validated onset, phase or event labels.

findings.observation: Persistent long-period oscillations occur before and during alignment at CSOB/COLB/CFB1, without a convincing isolated common onset in these displayed windows.
findings.status: unconfirmed; no analytical label or filter added

findings.observation: The selected CNIS/CFB3/CFB1 windows contain sustained oscillations before and after the predicted arrival; the negative FI does not isolate an event onset.
findings.status: unconfirmed; no analytical label or filter added

findings.observation: Impulsive energy near the own P pick is visible at CSTH and CSOB, where station FI is positive. The most negative-FI example, CFB1, has negative SNR and persistent oscillatory motion; the negative station mean is not sufficient evidence of a hybrid.
findings.status: unconfirmed; no analytical label or filter added

findings.observation: CFB3 and CCAP show persistent slow oscillations, while CLAC has nearly stationary higher-rate oscillations. No secure new common transient is apparent at the predicted alignment in this selection.
findings.status: unconfirmed; no analytical label or filter added

findings.observation: CQUE has a clear impulsive packet and positive FI; CAAM also has positive FI. The negative-FI CUMA window is low-SNR and lacks a clear onset. No hybrid classification follows from the station average.
findings.status: unconfirmed; no analytical label or filter added

findings.observation: The association already fails causality. CRUS has a later impulsive packet and positive FI; CUMA has persistent low-SNR motion and negative FI. These windows do not validate the initial association or establish a hybrid.
findings.status: unconfirmed; no analytical label or filter added

findings.observation: CREM has an impulsive onset and positive FI. CSFT has a later larger packet outside the FI window; CUMA has near-zero SNR and negative FI. The negative mean does not establish a hybrid family.
findings.status: unconfirmed; no analytical label or filter added

findings.observation: Large CMIS energy begins before the predicted arrival and decays through the FI window. CUMA/CBAG contain overlapping energy and other provisional arrivals. Coda contamination and association splitting require review; no isolated hybrid is confirmed.
findings.status: unconfirmed; no analytical label or filter added

findings.observation: The CMIS FI window lies on the decaying tail of the earlier strong packet. CBAG/CMTS also contain overlapping arrivals. The low mean FI is compatible with coda contamination and does not establish a separate hybrid.
findings.status: unconfirmed; no analytical label or filter added

limitations: These selected windows do not supply complete multistation onset review, a false-positive rate, reviewed ground truth, or a three-year hybrid catalog. Automated station measurement reviewed flags remain false because no reviewed onset annotations were assigned.
